Strategy: Square-root peak at twice the item size: score falls with the square root of the distance between a bin's residual and 2*item, so the preferred bin leaves exactly one item-sized gap; the concave root compresses large distances, treating far-off bins nearly alike while still separating near misses. It can fail when the flat far-field lets a much tighter bin lose to a mediocre near-peak bin.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-sqrt(abs(r - 2 * item)) for r in bins]
```
